requirement_vague: Verify article filtering by tag works correctly

omissions.description: GET /api/articles does not support filtering articles by the tag query parameter.
omissions.reasoning: The list_articles route only declares query parameters author, limit, and offset. There is no tag parameter in the function signature, so requests like /api/articles?tag=javascript are ignored rather than used for filtering.

omissions.description: Article listing logic does not filter returned articles by tag membership.
omissions.reasoning: Inside list_articles, the query starts with select(Article) and only applies an author-based filter. It then returns all matching articles without any condition involving Article.tags, Tag.name, or the ArticleTagLink table, so the required counts and article subsets for javascript/testing/nonexistent tags cannot be produced.
